name: Sixteen-Word Cube-Chordal Projection Counterexample
definition: On coordinates 0,...,4, encode x by sum_i 2^i x_i. The complete word set is [0, 1, 2, 3, 6, 7, 8, 9, 16, 17, 18, 19, 21, 23, 24, 26].
properties: Cube-chordal ample; deleting coordinate 4 gives the non-cube-chordal ten-word class.
